tasks.label: Docker: install
tasks.command: docker compose run --rm node npm ci

tasks.label: Docker: build
tasks.command: docker compose run --rm node npm run build

tasks.label: Docker: test
tasks.command: docker compose run --rm node npm test

tasks.label: Docker: test consumer
tasks.command: docker compose run --rm node npm run test:consumer

tasks.label: Docker: test gallery
tasks.command: docker compose run --rm node sh -c 'npm run build:gallery && npm run test:gallery'

tasks.label: Docker: format check
tasks.command: docker compose run --rm node npm run format

tasks.label: Docker: gallery (http://localhost:5173/dossier/)
tasks.command: docker rm -f dossier-gallery >/dev/null 2>&1; docker compose run --rm --name dossier-gallery -p 127.0.0.1:5173:5173 node npm run dev:gallery

tasks.label: Docker: storybook (http://localhost:6006)
tasks.command: docker rm -f dossier-storybook >/dev/null 2>&1; docker compose run --rm --name dossier-storybook -p 127.0.0.1:6006:6006 node npm run storybook

tasks.label: Docker: build storybook
tasks.command: docker compose run --rm node npm run build:storybook
